content.value: A slab of width 1ft and clear span of 14 ft is to be designed for a village canal. Assume that the slab is simply supported and a concentráted load of 280 lb acts at the mid span as worst condition of loading in addition to its self-weight. Find thickness and amount of main reinforcement by WSD method. Show reinforcement detailing with neat sketch. fc = 2500 psi, fy= 50,000 psi.
